description: This file defines a custom DOM parser class for clipboard content in the Notesnook project, including functions for processing HTML elements such as code blocks, checklists, and premium features removal, tailored for the application's editing features.

classes.name: ClipboardDOMParser
classes.description: A custom DOM parser extending ProsemirrorDOMParser, with overridden parse and parseSlice methods to preprocess clipboard HTML content.

methods.name: removeBlockId
methods.description: Removes 'data-block-id' attributes from all elements in the DOM.

methods.name: formatCodeblocks
methods.description: Reformats <pre> and <div class="w3-code"> blocks to standardize code formatting and infer language for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: convertBrToSingleSpacedParagraphs
methods.description:
Converts
tags into separate single-spaced paragraphs, splitting or wrapping text nodes as needed.

methods.name: convertGoogleDocsChecklist
methods.description: Transforms Google Docs-style checklists into a standardized checklist format.
